result.brief: 提出像素空间分组生成模型 PixText，仅重绘目标区域以精修场景文字，并指出 VAE 潜空间重建会丢失细笔画，附四步 MeanFlow 高效生成与评测基准。
result.reason: Pixel-space grouped image generation for local text refinement; critiques VAE latent reconstruction loss of fine strokes, relevant to RAE/generative latent space and image generation efficiency.
